/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qsl
from solution import patch_query

cases = [
    ('https://example.invalid/p?a=1&a=2&blank=#keep', [], [('a','1'),('a','2'),('blank','')]),
    ('/p?a=1&b=2&a=3', [('a','4')], [('b','2'),('a','4')]),
    ('/p?a=1&b=2', [('a','')], [('b','2'),('a','')]),
    ('/p?%61=1&A=2&a=3&z=', [('a',None)], [('A','2'),('z','')]),
    ('../p?a=1&b=2', [('a','x'),('c','3'),('a','y'),('c',None)], [('b','2'),('a','y')]),
    ('//example.invalid/p#fragment', [('雪 &+%=','雪 &+%=')], [('雪 &+%=','雪 &+%=')]),
    ('?a=1&a=&b=2', [('missing',None)], [('a','1'),('a',''),('b','2')]),
]
for url, updates, expected in cases:
    snapshot = updates.copy()
    result = urlsplit(patch_query(url, updates))
    original = urlsplit(url)
    assert parse_qsl(result.query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected
    assert (result.scheme,result.netloc,result.path,result.fragment) == (original.scheme,original.netloc,original.path,original.fragment)
    assert updates == snapshot

class OnePass:
    def __init__(self): self.used = False
    def __iter__(self):
        assert not self.used, 'iterated twice'
        self.used = True
        yield 'a', ''
        yield 'b', '雪 &+%='
        yield 'a', None
assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(patch_query('/?a=1', OnePass())).query, keep_blank_values=True) == [('b','雪 &+%=')]
assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(patch_query('/?x=0', ((k,v) for k,v in [('x','1'),('x','2')]))).query) == [('x','2')]
print('9 targeted cases passed; URL components and input immutability checked.')
PY
"
